USA vs Belgium: Preview USMNT hosts Belgium in Atlanta, looking to prove a point ahead of hosting this summer's World Cup.Unbeaten in five games, Mauricio Pochettino's side hammered Uruguay 5-1 last time out, back in November and will be looking to follow up on that success.After losing the Concaf Gold Cup last year, the US are in decent form but will have their work cut out against a talented European outfit.AC Milan attacker Christian Pulisic, Juventus midfielder Weston McKennie and Crystal Palace centre-back Chris Richards are all included for the upcoming internationals. ▶︎ READ MORE: How to watch World Cup Qualifiers 2026 — Stream play-off matches for free Belgium flew through qualifying, topping Group J without losing a single game.A tough test awaits in Atlanta but with their golden generation now ageing, it remains to be seen how Rudi Garcia's fare at the World Cup this summer.Conceding just seven goals in eight games, the Red Devils have plenty of Premier League stars are in their ranks.Jeremy Doku, Amadou Onana, Maxim De Cuyper and Senne Lammens, who's having a great debut season between the sticks for fellow Red Devils, Manchester United, are all feature.
